name: Nalu Vida
facts: Nalu Vida is at 1 Washington Blvd, Venice, CA 90292, at the foot of the Venice Pier.
Phone: (310) 437-0060. Email: info@naluvida.com. Instagram: @naluvidavenice.
Hours: Mon-Thu 11 AM-12 AM, Fri 10 AM-2 AM, Sat 9 AM-2 AM, Sun 9 AM-12 AM.
Brunch is served daily until 4 PM, with $24 bottomless mimosas (60 min).
Happy hour is Mon-Fri 3-6 PM and 10 PM-close, dine-in only.
Burger Mondays: $9 burgers and a $5 draft beer special, 5 PM to close.
Taco Tuesday: 50% off signature tacos all day and $10 house margaritas.
Shuckin' Good Wednesday: $2 oysters (min 6), while supplies last.
NFL Sunday: every NFL game on the TVs, plus bottomless mimosas.
Parking: public beach lot next to the pier, plus street parking.
Book a table on Resy. A 20% gratuity is added for parties of 6 or more.
Private events: parties of 10 to 100 people. The tour is free and so is your drink.
Nalu Vida Rewards is free to join. One account per person.
You earn 10 points per $1 on eligible purchases, before tip.
Join bonus: +100 points. Birthday bonus: +250 once a year. Referral: +100 per friend.
Rewards: 250 pts, 500 pts, 1,000 pts and 1,500 pts.
Ride the Nalu: 1 point per 100 game score, up to 50 game points a day.
You can play Ride the Nalu without an account.
The weekly game board is for bragging rights only. There is no prize.
One reward per visit, one prize per day. A reward pass works once and expires 10 minutes after it opens.
Rewards have no cash value and can't be transferred. Rewards are never free alcohol.
Nalu Vida has its own points balance, separate from sister spot Melody Bar & Grill.
Order from your phone: pick Patio, Bar, Dining room or Rooftop.
Pay your server or bartender like normal.
The app has a language menu (English, Spanish, Chinese, Korean and more).
Live scores in the app cover NFL, college football, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, WNBA, college hoops and UFC.

qa.q: Is gratuity added for big groups?
qa.a: Yes, 20% gratuity is added for parties of 6 or more.

qa.q: Can I host a private event?
qa.a: Yes, for parties of 10 to 100 people. Come see the space: the tour is free and so is your drink. Tap 'Plan an event' in the app.

qa.q: How do I join Nalu Vida Rewards?
qa.a: Joining is free. Use the Rewards section of the app. It's one account per person.

qa.q: Do I need an account to play the game?
qa.a: No. Ride the Nalu is free to play with or without an account. Join the same day to save the points you earn.
You earn 10 points per $1 on eligible purchases, before tip. You also earn bonus points for joining, your birthday, referrals and the game.
10 points for every $1 on eligible purchases, before tip.

qa.q: How do I get points for my visit?
qa.a: Tap 'Add my visit' and snap your receipt or type the check number, total and date (today or yesterday). Once Toast is connected this will be automatic.

qa.q: Is there a limit on adding a receipt?
qa.a: One receipt per member per day, each check only once, up to $150 per check.
Yes, the date can be today or yesterday.

qa.q: Do I earn points on tip?
qa.a: No, points are 10 per $1 on eligible purchases before tip.
I don't have the full list of what isn't eligible. Ask staff or call (310) 437-0060.
Yes. Claims are checked against the restaurant's sales report, and points from made-up checks are removed.

qa.q: How many points do I get for joining?
qa.a: +100 points once, when you join.
Yes, you get +250 points once a year on your birthday when you're a member.
Share your code. You get +100 points for each friend who joins with your code and makes a first visit.

qa.q: Can I enter a friend's referral code later?
qa.a: No. You enter one friend's code once, when you join. It can't be changed later, and you can't use your own.

qa.q: Can a referral stack with another reward?
qa.a: No, a referral never stacks with another reward on the same visit.

250 pts: free mocktail, soft drink or Jungle Fries. 500 pts: free shareable (Chips, Salsa & Guac, Calamari or Wings). 1,000 pts: $10 off your check. 1,500 pts: free entrée (any Signature Island Tacos or the Poke Bowl).
A free mocktail, soft drink or Jungle Fries.
A free shareable: Chips, Salsa & Guac, Calamari or Wings.

qa.q: How do I use a reward?
qa.a: Tap 'Use reward' and show the live pass to your server, who applies it in Toast. The points come off when you open the pass.

qa.q: How long does a reward pass last?
qa.a: 10 minutes after it opens, and it works once. Each visit gets a fresh one-time code.

qa.q: Can I use more than one reward a day?
qa.a: No. It's one reward per visit and one prize per day (Los Angeles date). A second one shows 'Come back tomorrow'.

qa.q: Can I get free alcohol with points?
qa.a: No. Rewards are never free alcohol.

qa.q: Can I give my reward to someone else?
qa.a: No. Rewards have no cash value and can't be transferred.
Points you've earned stay in your balance unless the program ends. I don't have expiry details beyond that, so ask staff.
Nalu Vida can change the program, point values or rewards with notice in the app.
No levels. It's one simple points balance and one rewards ladder (250, 500, 1,000 and 1,500).

qa.q: Is there a daily spin or prize wheel?
qa.a: No. There's no daily spin, prize wheel, lucky draw or tokens. Just points.

qa.q: Are there early-bird or location bonuses?
qa.a: I don't have details on early-bird or location bonuses. Ask staff or call (310) 437-0060.

qa.q: Do Nalu Vida points work at Melody?
qa.a: No. Nalu Vida has its own balance, and points don't move between restaurants.
A surfing game on the Venice Pier loop with 5 levels: paddle out, grab food rafts, then ride the wave home. It's free to play.

qa.q: How do I play Ride the Nalu?
qa.a: Drag left and right to steer. Paddling out, tap DUCK DIVE under each breaking wave. Riding in, tap JUMP to launch off the lip, then TRICK in the air and land it.
Drag to steer. Tap JUMP (or swipe up) to duck-dive or launch. In the air, tap TRICK or swipe: sideways is a 360, down is a grab, up is a flip.

qa.q: How do I score in the game?
qa.a: Grab food rafts (Island Tacos +100, Mimosa +120, Jungle Fries +120, Smash-N-Stack +150, Coconut Shrimp +150). Duck-dive waves for +100, stay in the pocket, ride out the barrel for +200, and land tricks.

qa.q: What hurts me in the game?
qa.a: Bumping sea life like stingrays is a mild wipeout. Riding in, the white foam costs half a heart and 100 points. Landing mid-trick is a small bail (-150).

qa.q: How many lives do I have?
qa.a: You have 5 hearts, lost in halves. At zero, the run ends.
Grab 4 in a row for x2, 8 for x3 and so on. A hit resets it.
Level 1 is about 2 minutes (30 seconds paddling out, 90 seconds riding). Later levels have a shorter paddle-out.
Ride all 5 levels for a big finish bonus. I don't have the exact number to share.

qa.q: How many game points can I earn?
qa.a: 1 point for every 100 game score, up to 50 game points a day (Los Angeles date). They go to your Nalu Vida Rewards balance.
As often as you like, and it's free. Only the points are capped at 50 game points a day.

qa.q: I played without joining. Are my points lost?
qa.a: No. Today's points are held on your phone. Join the same day to save them.

qa.q: Does the game give prizes or discounts?
qa.a: No. The game earns rewards points only. It doesn't give prizes, codes or discounts directly.

qa.q: How does the weekly leaderboard work?
qa.a: There's a weekly board for bragging rights only, and it resets every Monday. The app's champion card counts down to Sunday 11:00 PM.

qa.q: What do I win as weekly champion?
qa.a: Bragging rights. The weekly board has no prize.

qa.q: When are weekly prizes picked up?
qa.a: There are no weekly prizes, since the board is for bragging rights only. Rewards are used with a live pass at the table.
Yes. There are no weapons or boss fights. Bumping into anything is just a splash, then you pop back up.
I don't have a kid mode to tell you about. The game itself has no weapons or boss fights.

qa.q: Can I cheat or use multiple accounts?
qa.a: No. Scores made with cheats, scripts, bots or multiple accounts don't count.

qa.q: Can I change the music or graphics?
qa.a: Yes. In game Settings you can pick the song (Cheat Code or Xtreme Rich Person) and set Graphics, Weather and Time of day. These are visual only.
A switch for a real 3D ocean, wave and surfer. It turns itself off on phones that can't keep it smooth.

qa.q: Can I use a game controller?
qa.a: The game supports controllers in most browsers. Pair one, press a button, and use the stick or D-pad. Tap the controller help in the game for details.
Yes. At the start you choose 'She rides' or 'He rides'.

qa.q: What is the review video in the game?
qa.a: A short break may play between levels with Antidote The Foodie's review of Nalu Vida. Skip it if you like.

qa.q: Is there a hidden bonus in the game?
qa.a: Yes. A billboard buoy floats by the pier once a run. Ride through it for a +500 bonus.

qa.q: Where can I see live scores?
qa.a: Tap 'Live scores' in the app. It covers NFL, college football, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, WNBA, college hoops and UFC, with LA teams.

qa.q: Can I pick winners for games?
qa.a: The scores section has pick-the-winner, but picks don't earn points here.

qa.q: Can I order from my phone?
qa.a: Yes. Pick where you're sitting (Patio, Bar, Dining room or Rooftop), add items, and send your order.

qa.q: What if I scanned a table code?
qa.a: Your seat is already picked. Otherwise choose your spot and, except at the bar, tap your table number (1-20).
Pay your server or bartender like normal. The app shows your subtotal and tax before you send.

qa.q: Is tax shown in the app order?
qa.a: Yes, the order sheet shows subtotal, tax and total.

qa.q: What if an item says MP?
qa.a: MP means market price. Ask your server for the price (oysters are MP).

qa.q: Do you have gluten-free or allergy info?
qa.a: I don't have allergy or gluten-free details. Please ask your server or call (310) 437-0060.

qa.q: Do you have a kids menu?

qa.q: Do you offer takeout or delivery?
qa.a: I don't have takeout or delivery details. The app orders are for dine-in at your seat. Call (310) 437-0060.
I don't have a dress code. Ask staff or call (310) 437-0060.

qa.q: What languages does the app support?
qa.a: Tap the 🌐 pill to switch: English, Spanish, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Korean, Tagalog, Vietnamese, Armenian, Persian, Japanese, Thai or Russian. Names like Nalu Vida stay in English.

qa.q: Can I install the app on my phone?
qa.a: Yes. Use 'Add to Home Screen' (Share then Add to Home Screen on iPhone, or the browser menu on Android) so it opens like an app.

qa.q: Is there a digital rewards card?
qa.a: Yes. Tap 'My Rewards Card' to see your name, card ID, points, a QR code and your next reward.

qa.q: Can I add the card to Apple or Google Wallet?
qa.a: Not yet. The wallet buttons aren't turned on, but you can add the app to your Home Screen.

qa.q: Who do I ask for help?
qa.a: Ask your server or bartender, or call (310) 437-0060 or email info@naluvida.com.

qa.q: What does the app record about me?
qa.a: When you open the app (at most once every 10 minutes) it records the time, a short device summary, a random phone ID and your member ID if you joined. Location is approximate and only if you already turned it on for this app.
No. It's seen only by the restaurant's owner and SousShift AI, never sold and not used for ads.

qa.q: How do I turn off location?
qa.a: Turn location off for this site or app in your phone's Settings. The app never asks for location just for this, and nothing runs in the background.

qa.q: Do you have a sister restaurant?
qa.a: Yes, Melody Bar & Grill by LAX (9132 S Sepulveda Blvd, Los Angeles), phone (310) 670-1994. It has its own app and points balance.
